analytics.pageDesc: Regional AI maturity trends and impact metrics
analytics.keyInsightsDesc: Important findings from the Arab AI ecosystem analysis
analytics.insight1Desc: The Arab AI ecosystem has grown by 155% since 2020, with increasing participation from the private sector.
analytics.insight2Desc: Healthcare AI represents 20% of all regional initiatives, driven by pandemic response and digital health transformation.
analytics.insight3Desc: 5 countries account for 70% of AI activity, with Egypt and UAE leading in project count.
analytics.insight4Desc: Machine Learning dominates with 38% of all projects, followed by Computer Vision at 30%.
